section.content: 本实用新型公开一种锂离子电池，包括正极片、负极片和电解液，所述正极片包括正极集流体，所述正极集流体朝向所述负极片的一侧涂覆有正极活性物质层；所述负极片包括负极集流体，所述负极集流体朝向所述正极片的一侧涂覆有负极活性物质层；所述正极活性物质层或所述负极活性物质层上依次涂覆有绝缘层和粘结层。与现有技术相比，由于没有隔膜，能够杜绝隔膜热缩的隐患，降低了电池的隐患，提高了锂离子电池的安全性。

The utility model discloses a lithium ion battery, which comprises a positive plate, a negative plate and electrolyte, wherein the positive plate comprises a positive current collector, and one side of the positive current collector, which faces the negative plate, is coated with a positive active material layer; the negative plate comprises a negative current collector, and a negative active material layer is coated on one side, facing the positive plate, of the negative current collector; and the positive electrode active material layer or the negative electrode active material layer is coated with an insulating layer and a bonding layer in sequence. Compared with the prior art, because no diaphragm is arranged, the hidden danger of thermal shrinkage of the diaphragm can be avoided, the hidden danger of the battery is reduced, and the safety of the lithium ion battery is improved.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a battery field, concretely relates to lithium ion battery.

Background

At present, with the rapid development of new energy automobiles and electronic devices such as mobile phones, digital cameras and notebook computers, the market demand for high-power, high-energy-density batteries is increasing. The lithium ion battery has the characteristics of high voltage and high energy density, and has a good development prospect.

The traditional lithium ion battery structure is a positive plate, a diaphragm and a negative plate, the diaphragm is usually made of PE or PP materials, and thermal shrinkage and even fusion can occur under the condition of higher temperature, so that potential battery hazards are caused.

In view of the above, the present inventors have made extensive studies on the above-mentioned drawbacks of the prior art, and have made this invention.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

A primary object of the present invention is to provide a lithium ion battery, which does not have a diaphragm structure, and does not produce thermal shrinkage, thereby eliminating the hidden danger caused by thermal shrinkage of the diaphragm.

In order to achieve the above purpose, the solution of the present invention is:

a lithium ion battery comprises a positive plate, a negative plate and electrolyte, wherein the positive plate comprises a positive current collector, and a positive active material layer is coated on one side, facing the negative plate, of the positive current collector; the negative plate comprises a negative current collector, and a negative active material layer is coated on one side, facing the positive plate, of the negative current collector; and the positive electrode active material layer or the negative electrode active material layer is coated with an insulating layer and a bonding layer in sequence.

Further, the positive active material layer comprises one or more of lithium cobaltate, lithium manganate, lithium nickel cobalt manganate, lithium iron phosphate, lithium titanate or lithium nickel cobalt aluminate.

Further, the negative electrode active material layer comprises one or more of graphite, mesocarbon microbeads, hard carbon, soft carbon, lithium titanate and silicon carbon.

Further, the insulating layer comprises one or more of barium sulfate, aluminum oxide, zirconium oxide or magnesium oxide.

Further, the tie layer comprises PVDF or an acrylate.

Further, the thickness of the insulating layer is 8-40 microns.

After the structure is adopted, the utility model relates to a lithium ion battery, it has following beneficial effect at least:

the adhesive layer separates the positive plate and the negative plate, ions can pass through but electrons cannot pass through, and the adhesive layer plays a role in replacing the diaphragm.

And secondly, the insulating layer plays a role in cutting off current, so that the risk of thermal runaway of the battery is reduced, and the battery has better safety performance. Under the conditions of overcharge and short circuit, the insulating layer plays a role in reducing current, thereby reducing heat release and avoiding thermal runaway.

Compared with the prior art, because no diaphragm is arranged, the hidden danger of thermal shrinkage of the diaphragm can be avoided, the hidden danger of the battery is reduced, and the safety of the lithium ion battery is improved.

Drawings

Fig. 1 is a schematic structural view of an insulating layer and an adhesive layer disposed on a positive electrode sheet.

Fig. 2 is a schematic structural diagram of an insulating layer and an adhesive layer disposed on a negative electrode sheet.

In the figure: a positive plate 1; a positive current collector 11; a positive electrode active material layer 12; a negative plate 2; a negative electrode current collector 21; the anode active material layer 22; an insulating layer 3; and an adhesive layer 4.

Detailed Description

In order to further explain the technical solution of the present invention, the present invention is explained in detail by the following embodiments.

As shown in fig. 1 to fig. 2, the lithium ion battery according to the present invention includes a positive plate 1, a negative plate 2 and an electrolyte, wherein the positive plate 1 includes a positive current collector 11, and a positive active material layer 12 is coated on one side of the positive current collector 11 facing the negative plate 2; the negative electrode sheet 2 comprises a negative electrode current collector 21, and the side of the negative electrode current collector 21 facing the positive electrode sheet 1 is coated with a negative electrode active material layer 22; the positive electrode active material layer 12 or the negative electrode active material layer 22 is coated with an insulating layer 3 and an adhesive layer 4 in this order. Preferably, the tie layer 4 comprises PVDF or an acrylate. One side of the insulating layer 3 is connected to the adhesive layer 4, and the other side of the insulating layer 3 is connected to the positive electrode active material layer 12 or the negative electrode active material layer 22.

Thus, the utility model relates to a lithium ion battery, the adhesive linkage separates positive plate 1 and negative pole piece 2, and the ion can pass through and not allow the electron to pass through, from tie coat 4 plays the effect of replacing the diaphragm. The insulating layer 3 plays a role in cutting off current, so that the risk of thermal runaway of the battery is reduced, and the battery has better safety performance. Further, the thickness of the insulating layer 3 is 8 to 40 μm.

Preferably, the positive electrode active material layer 12 includes one or more of lithium cobaltate, lithium manganate, lithium nickel cobalt manganate, lithium iron phosphate, lithium titanate or lithium nickel cobalt aluminate for providing a lithium source.

Preferably, the negative electrode active material layer 22 includes one or more of graphite, mesocarbon microbeads and derivatives thereof, hard carbon, soft carbon, lithium titanate, or silicon carbon, and is used for storing lithium ions deintercalated from the positive electrode.

Preferably, the insulating layer 3 comprises one or more of barium sulfate, aluminum oxide, zirconium oxide or magnesium oxide; the insulating layer 3 functions to block current.

Compared with the prior art, because no diaphragm is arranged, the hidden danger of thermal shrinkage of the diaphragm can be avoided, the hidden danger of the battery is reduced, and the safety of the lithium ion battery is improved.

The above embodiments and drawings are not intended to limit the form and style of the present invention, and any suitable changes or modifications made by those skilled in the art should not be construed as departing from the scope of the present invention.
